chapter.title: Estimation, Hypothesis Tests and Confidence Procedures

missing_pieces.duty: assessment_dispute: US-0 partial: the planned extent 'Exact, asymptotic and boundary regimes' is met only for the Student mean procedures. The new chapter sec:p15-w02b-p15-059 restricts itself in so many words to 'the other two regimes in which those procedures are used' (body lines 6-9). Nowhere on the route (searched across handbook/parts/p15) is there large-sample theory for tests and confidence procedures in general: no likelihood-ratio/Wilks chi-square limit, and no Wald or score tests or Wald intervals built from the asymptotically normal likelihood roots of 169.1-169.4.

assessment_dispute: US-0 partial: the boundary regime is represented only by the uniform support endpoint and the Student n=2, V=0 boundary cases. There is no regime with the true parameter on the boundary of the parameter space, for example chi-bar-square or mixture limits.
assessment_dispute: All 34 linked Neyman and Student components and the new chapter's proofs are covered; only the section-extent duty US-0 is short.
